title: Vasectomy and Tubal Ligation
summary: Sterilisation is permanent contraception: a vasectomy blocks the tubes that carry sperm; tubal ligation (tubectomy) blocks or removes the fallopian tubes. Both are highly effective and meant to be permanent.
key_points: A vasectomy doesn't affect erections, orgasm or testosterone.
After a vasectomy, backup contraception is needed until a test confirms no sperm.
